text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well, um… My skin has been feeling kind of rough lately. Especially on my cheeks…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …You think it's because it's dry and irritated? M-maybe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What should I do? …Uh-huh. So, keep my skin moisturized and make sure I eat lots of whole foods…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Okay, I'll try focusing on that and see if it helps. …Uh-huh. Thanks, Mom!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I hope it gets better soon…
